title: Minimal valid two-state recursive trajectory
description: A minimal synthetic trajectory with two states and one transition. Demonstrates a valid GROUND operation. Used to verify that the instrument accepts a well-formed recursive transition.
purpose: Verify schema acceptance of a minimal valid trajectory; establish baseline instrument behavior.

states.description: Initial hypothesis: the CSH experiment is blocked because the serving platform retired.
Grounded successor: HTTP 410 responses are bound to exact artifacts, establishing the platform retirement as OBSERVED rather than HYPOTHESIZED.

transitions.tau_n_description: State 0 hypothesizes platform retirement; this is a tension because it is ungrounded. Grounding reduces H_g.

raw_candidates.summary: Ground the platform retirement claim by binding HTTP 410 evidence to PAIR001_POST_EXECUTION_ADJUDICATION.
Expand to cover all 108 units as platform-retired without individual execution.

rejections.rationale: Expanding all 108 units to platform-retired without execution would promote UNRESOLVED adjudication to DERIVED without authorization. EPR violation.
